name: guard-desktop

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='node_modules/boolean/package.json'; if(fs.existsSync(p)){ const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); if(j.devDependencies&&j.devDependencies.roboter){ delete j.devDependencies.roboter; fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(j,null,2)); } }"
